title: GIG-4063: Export Declared Secrets Into Host Pre Start Commands
description: Exports declared ngramx secrets into host pre_start commands and seeds parent auth.json into worktrees so Nova Composer auth no longer fails when those values live only in .env.

test_plan.description: Host pre_start expands secrets that live only in .env
steps: In a project whose ngramx.yml requires NOVA_ACCOUNT_EMAIL and NOVA_LICENSE_KEY from .env, unset those variables in the shell
Confirm the values are present in .env
Run ngramx worktree for a ticket so pre_start runs composer config http-basic.nova.laravel.com $NOVA_ACCOUNT_EMAIL $NOVA_LICENSE_KEY
Confirm that step succeeds and the worktree has auth.json

test_plan.description: Worktree auth.json matches the parent after up
steps: Confirm the parent checkout has an auth.json for nova.laravel.com
Create a worktree and wait until up finishes
Confirm the worktree auth.json username matches the parent, not a different .env account
Confirm the PHP 8.2 CI job is green
Confirm composer phpstan reports no errors on src/Executor/HostCommandExecutor.php
